h1: Sell or rent out your property with GUREVIĆ

hero.lead: We take on apartments, houses, land, construction projects and operating businesses in Budva and elsewhere in Montenegro. We value the property, prepare it for sale or rent and see it through to the deal under a written agreement.

facts.languages: We speak Russian, English and Montenegrin

agency.title: A real estate agency in Budva
agency.p1: GUREVIĆ (DOO GUREVIC BUDVA) is a real estate agency in Budva, run by its owner and agent Ilia Gurevich. You discuss the price, the terms and the progress of the sale directly with the person who handles your deal.
agency.p2: We are in our third year on the Montenegrin property market and now work in a new format: separate services for buyers, tenants, investors and owners, written agreements, and partners for legal support, design and construction.
agency.p3: On the seller's side we also take on investment assets — development land, construction projects, hotels, restaurants and other operating businesses. Details of such assets are shared with buyers confidentially.

meta.title: Sell property in Montenegro | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Sell an apartment, house, land or business in Budva and Montenegro: valuation, photography, viewings, negotiation. Commission 5% excl. VAT, written agreement.

sell.lead: We value the property, prepare it for sale and negotiate with buyers. You deal with one person and receive reports on how the sale is going.

valuation.title: Valuation
valuation.text: We analyse the property, the area and the market and agree the asking price with you.

photo.title: Photography and description
photo.text: We photograph the property and prepare the listing description.

listing.title: Listing
listing.text: We publish the property on the agency website and our channels and answer buyers' enquiries.

viewings.title: Viewings
viewings.text: We hold viewings on a schedule agreed with you and report the results.

negotiation.title: Negotiation
negotiation.text: We pass buyers' offers on to you and help agree the price and terms.

deal.title: Deal support
deal.text: We help prepare the documents and support you until the sale contract is signed.

terms.commission_html: Agency commission of 5% excl. VAT; other terms by agreement.
terms.exclusive: An exclusive agreement is preferred: one point of contact instead of every agent and agency in Montenegro.
terms.contract: A written agreement in accordance with the laws of Montenegro.

price.q: How much do your services cost?
price.a: The agency commission is 5% excluding VAT. Other terms are discussed individually and set out in a written agreement.

exclusive.q: Do I have to sign an exclusive agreement?
exclusive.a: No, but we recommend it: you deal with one agency instead of every agent in Montenegro, the property is on the market at one price, and viewings follow an agreed schedule.

documents.q: Which documents do I need to submit a request?
documents.a: None. The title deed number, cadastral municipality (KO) and, for an apartment, the unit number (PD) help us verify the property faster. The full set of documents is needed when the agreement is signed.

price_change.q: Who decides whether to change the price?
price_change.a: Only the owner. We agree any price change with you in advance.

business.q: Can I sell an operating business or a construction project?
business.a: Yes. We also take on investment assets on the seller's side. Business details are shared only with qualified buyers and, where needed, after an NDA is signed.

sell.form_intro: Tell us about the property — no documents are needed at this stage. Cadastral details are used only to verify the property.

meta.title: Rent out your property in Budva | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Long-term letting of an apartment or house in Budva and Montenegro — until the season or for a year: rental rate, photos, tenant search and lease agreement.

rent_out.lead: We help you let an apartment or house for a longer term — until the season or for a year: we assess the rental rate, find a tenant and prepare the lease.

rate.title: Rental rate assessment
rate.text: We suggest a long-term rate — until the season or for a year — based on the area, condition and market supply.

photo.title: Photography and description
photo.text: We photograph the property and prepare the listing description.

search.title: Tenant search and screening
search.text: We get to know the candidates and check the term, occupants, pets and budget. The final decision is yours.

viewings.title: Viewings
viewings.text: We hold viewings on a schedule agreed with you.

lease.title: Lease agreement
lease.text: We help prepare the lease: term, deposit, utilities and the handover of the property.

terms.term: Long-term lets only: until the season or for a year.

term.q: For how long do you let properties?
term.a: We work with long-term lets — until the start of the season or for a year. Short-term rentals are still in development.

price.q: How much do your services cost?
price.a: Commission and terms are discussed individually and agreed in writing.

tenant.q: How do you choose a tenant?
tenant.a: We get to know the candidates, check the term, the occupants, pets and budget, and pass this information on to you. The decision to let is yours.

presence.q: Do I need to attend the viewings?
presence.a: Not necessarily: viewings can be held with keys left with the agency. This is agreed when the agreement is signed.

rent_out.form_intro: Tell us about the property and the rental term you have in mind. No documents are needed at this stage.

meta.title: Property management in Budva | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Property management in Budva for owners: key holding, utility bills, property checks and coordination of contractors. Terms are agreed individually.

management.lead: For owners who do not live in Montenegro full-time or let their property long-term. The tasks and terms are agreed individually.
management.included_note: There is no fixed package: we agree on the tasks you actually need.

keys.title: Key holding
keys.text: The agency keeps the keys — for viewings, tradespeople and emergencies.

bills.title: Utilities and bills
bills.text: Checking and paying utility bills in an agreed way.

checks.title: Property checks
checks.text: Inspections at check-in and check-out of a long-term tenant and, by arrangement, during the tenancy.

maintenance.title: Maintenance and repairs
maintenance.text: Coordination of contractors; the cost of works is agreed with the owner in advance.

terms.scope: Tasks and reporting are agreed in advance.

scope.a: The tasks are agreed individually: for example, key holding, paying utility bills, property checks during a long-term let and coordinating repairs through contractors.

price.a: Terms are discussed individually and depend on the property and the tasks.

combine.q: Can management be combined with letting?
combine.a: Yes, we can discuss it: for example, finding a long-term tenant and staying in touch with them afterwards.

repairs.q: Do you carry out repairs yourselves?
repairs.a: No, we coordinate contractors. The cost of works is agreed with the owner in advance.

management.form_intro: Tell us about the property and which tasks you would like to hand over. No documents are needed at this stage.
